project: The Stock Market: From the Ground Up — Talia Market Tutor

classificationLegend.RELEASE_GATED: Specified acceptance, actual member security test outstanding
classificationLegend.OPEN_LEGAL_PRODUCT_REVIEW: Not settled by an internal decision record

decisions.decision: Tutor interactive endpoints require current authenticated eligible member, server-issued identity and tool access; deny anonymous, suspended, deleted, showcase and stale session.
decisions.release: Authenticated real member and negative-role tests

decisions.decision: Resolve Foundation, Advanced, Professional, Enterprise effective edition server-side using entitlement, add-on, release flag, and versioned audit; visual dropdown never grants privilege.
decisions.release: Two member paid/free upgrade/downgrade and forged tier requests

decisions.decision: Saving Tutor conversation exchanges is strictly affirmative opt-in, default off. A new unsaved topic must not be represented as deletion of historical saved exchanges.
decisions.release: Consent-off no persisted body, consent-on saved and reloaded

decisions.decision: Every conversation/history/feedback/export read or write is filtered by server-validated user ID, and RLS & API authorization enforced; client-submitted user_id ignored or denied.
decisions.release: Real two independent accounts, forged query/path/body ID and role boundaries

decisions.decision: On account switch, signout, session expiry or revoked membership, abort pending requests, clear transient transcript/chart/private cached data, reauthorize new token.
decisions.release: Race injection and stale in-flight response browser QA

decisions.decision: Provide user-visible access to consent scope and documented records retention, export and deletion; don't assert deletion before verified DB and backup retention policy is reviewed.
decisions.release: Document retention schedule, GDPR/US-state implications by served jurisdiction, RLS export/delete, audit log and backup caveat

decisions.decision: Ordinary source-only Explain/Teach Deeper, correction and ungraded retries are always free; no Lumen debit and no member AI credentials.
decisions.release: All eligible membership levels source-only free response and ledger unchanged

decisions.decision: No new billable provider or site-controlled inference without independent Owner budget approval, explicit optional member consent, finite server quota and safe deterministic fallback.
decisions.release: Model denied by default with zero paid calls; consent/zero quota negative checks

decisions.decision: Use original fictional OHLCV, original trade prints and separately labeled bar proxies for no-cost Tutor examples; chronological cutoff and source provenance required.
decisions.release: No-future synthetic/bar-to-trade distinction in real browser

decisions.decision: Preserve existing BYO Alpaca/Tiingo feeds for separately entitled member-owned market data without granting central republication or additional Tutor AI-key policy.
decisions.release: Feed plan/redistribution rights by provider/account; no cross-member data caching

decisions.decision: A free public URL is only a research citation. Do not copy vendor course prose, chart graphics, methods code, sample feeds or protected indices until individually licensed or independently rewritten where legally allowed.
decisions.release: Rights matrix per source, copyright, quote, automated processing, display and trademark

decisions.decision: FRED API terms and broader FRED service terms require series-specific rights review and restrict AI/ML applications, storage/caching and redistribution in relevant contexts. Disable automated model ingestion and redistribution by default.
decisions.release: Counsel/owner inspect live specific legal terms and relevant series; no FRED ingestion in V1

decisions.decision: Use SEC EDGAR/XBRL primary official references for fact checking; if automated retrieval is subsequently enabled, comply with SEC declaration, fair-access, rate and source-use policies; never infer filing as-of before public acceptance.
decisions.release: No uncontrolled SEC scraping, event as-of audit and attribution

decisions.decision: SCTR and official VIX remain conceptual education only; do not claim exact official numeric reproduction or authorized brand and feed usage.
decisions.release: Separate complete official formula/input/reference parity and license review

decisions.decision: Instructional, not personalized securities advice; no live broker execution, order placement or automatic trade signal from Tutor.
decisions.release: Unsafe prompt, order tool and risk-guarantee negative tests

decisions.decision: Never make real Assess answers, private rubrics, future replay, official grade or mastery award accessible via prompt, chat history, context or higher editions.
decisions.release: Adversarial Assess, replay and authorization tests

decisions.decision: No secrets, raw member responses or provider tokens in GitHub Actions artifacts, analytics, public app cache or support logs. Keep auditable decision IDs and sanitized QA metadata.
decisions.release: Observe errors/logs/traces for PII leakage and verify audit integrity

retentionNote: Retention/export/deletion and legal jurisdiction questions are unresolved, must be recorded separately and not represented as compliant.
sourceScopeNote: Financial and source-use policy is an internal implementation instruction, not legal advice or professional signoff.
